title: 1604CF item 4: the TIN branch code prints four compartments, and the only valid TIN is 3-3-3-5

subject.description: The fourth (branch-code) group of the item-4 TIN comb chain on page 1, in Part I (Background Information); the row's caption word 'TIN' prints at x 45.60-57.88 and item 5 'RDO Code' begins at x 258.24. The chain prints 58.56-94.32 / 106.56-142.08 / 155.76-191.52 / 204.24-250.80, all at y 129.84-144.72, separated not by dashes but by three grey filled boxes (gray 0.8902) at 94.32-106.56, 142.08-155.76 and 191.52-204.24, each also stroked black at 0.72pt. The printed pattern is 3+3+3+4. After the 2026-08-17 sitting the whole chain (not only this box) is reflowed to even 3-3-3-5 inside the original outer span; this printed box remains the PDF identity of the branch group.

reason: BIR's July-2008 artwork for 1604CF is CORRECT and OUT OF DATE — by one compartment, not two. It prints four compartments for the TIN branch code and pre-prints '000' in the first three, leaving the fourth blank. The only valid Philippine TIN is 3-3-3-5 (user rule of 2026-08-15), so a four-compartment branch box cannot hold a five-digit branch code. No rule can derive that width from 2008 ink that prints four boxes, which is precisely why this is a stage-2 correction and not a stage-1 producer bug (ARCHITECTURE.md, 'What belongs in which stage'): stage 1 read this artwork correctly, and its four emitted slots align with the three printed ticks to 0.00pt. What this record does NOT have, and C01 did, is a harvested declaration from BIR's own client — there is no rules/forms/1604cf*/fields.json in this checkout at all.

corpus_context.measured_on: census 2026-08-08, all 53 bundles, from the pinned PDFs only; this bundle re-measured directly on 2026-08-17
corpus_context.summary: The census found 39 of 53 bundles printing 3+3+3+5, three printing 3+3+3+3 (2550M Feb 2007, 2551M 2002, 2553 1999), one printing 3+3+3+4 (1600WP 2010) and ten not measurable by its method. 1604cf-2008 was one of the ten. Measured directly here it prints 3+3+3+4, so it joins 1600WP in the four-compartment class; on that reading the tally becomes 39 / 3 / 2 / 9, and this record's own measurement is the only evidence for the reclassification.
corpus_context.correction_to_the_census: tin-branch-census-20260808.json records forms['1604cf-2008'] as measured:false with reason 'no 3+3+3+N TIN chain measurable by this method'. That verdict is superseded for this bundle only, by direct measurement, and the census file is deliberately NOT edited: it is a pinned output of a named script on a named date, and rewriting it to agree with a later hand measurement is the class of failure this project has already paid for. The nine remaining bundles are still unmeasured; the slant blind spot described in the evidence above is a reason to re-examine them, not a reason to assume anything about them.
corpus_context.declaration_is_not_uniform_either: The harvested corpus does not declare 5 everywhere, and for this form it declares nothing at all. rules/forms/1601c-v2018/fields.json declares frm1601c:txtBranchCode max_length 3 while the 1601C artwork prints five compartments; rules/forms/1604f-v2018 declares 3 on page 1 and 5 on page 2 of the same form. 'The HTA always says 5' is false, and here there is no HTA record to consult in the first place.

filing_safety.harm: The return is filed against the wrong branch. 1604CF is the annual information return for income taxes withheld on compensation and final withholding taxes; its item-4 TIN identifies the withholding agent's registered establishment. If a five-digit branch code cannot be entered, the return lands on a truncated code — in practice branch 000, the head office — and the branch whose payees were actually withheld from files nothing, while the alphalists attached to it are attributed to the wrong unit.
filing_safety.who_is_affected: Every 1604CF filer whose branch code needs five digits, i.e. any registered branch numbered above 9999. On today's form they have no way to enter it at all: the box holds four characters.
filing_safety.today: Four compartments, '000' pre-printed in the first three and the fourth blank, all four typeable: the filer can enter up to four characters and nothing longer.
filing_safety.after: Five compartments over the same printed box; a five-digit branch code becomes enterable, at the cost of three of the five inputs containing a printed divider and every pre-printed zero straddling a compartment boundary.
